prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one production transparent layered character-rig atlas for Pico, the Horizons adventurous mountain hare, matching the second reference's exact friendly warm cream fur, navy oval eyes, orange inner ears, magenta satchel with orange clasp, soft borderless rounded illustration aesthetic. The first reference is a PARTS LAYOUT reference only: replace its blank face and ambiguous limb segments with a complete friendly face and unambiguous rounded joint caps. True alpha transparency, no colored background, no glow, no labels, no checkerboard artwork. Strict 4 columns by 4 rows with sixteen separate nonoverlapping cutouts, generous clear gutters, every part fully inside its cell. Each cell equal size. Row1 left to right: (1) complete head looking slightly viewer-right, include both navy eyes, eyebrows, nose, muzzle, open friendly smile, NO ears or neck; (2) intact pear-shaped torso with complete cream belly and high rounded neck/shoulder connection, NO arms legs accessories, no holes; (3) tall upright left ear with rounded attachment base; (4) floppy right ear with rounded attachment base. Row2: (1) screen-left upper arm pointing vertically down with rounded shoulder and elbow caps; (2) matching screen-left forearm pointing vertically down, rounded elbow cap at top and small relaxed paw with three toe lines at bottom; (3) screen-right upper arm pointing vertically down with rounded shoulder/elbow caps; (4) matching screen-right forearm vertically down with open friendly waving paw at bottom, elbow cap at top. Row3: (1) screen-left upper thigh pointing vertically down, rounded hip and knee caps; (2) matching screen-left lower leg vertically down with rounded knee at top and full left-looking large hare foot at bottom; (3) screen-right upper thigh vertically down, rounded hip/knee caps; (4) matching right lower leg vertically down with rounded knee and full right-looking large hare foot. Row4: (1) magenta satchel bag only, soft trapezoid with orange round clasp; (2) separate gently diagonal magenta satchel strap only; (3) open navy and cream book with two clear hands-free covers, no text; (4) small folded cream/orange illustrated town map, no text. Each head/torso native size natural proportions, limb parts designed to overlap at actual rounded joints. Ear bases, arm and leg endpoints have enough native pixels to remain continuous when rotated. No detached facial features. No assembled character. No third arms, no duplicate paws, no cut limbs. Transparent outside every object. Native large crisp atlas, preferably1536 square.
